title: The 478245 to 780239 leftovers are a CF-forced class and k=2 is a new Juggler shape
statement: At the leftover epsilon of the flight anchor 3.5e8, every parity leftover L in [478245, 780239] belongs to an explicit Ostrowski / lattice class forced by classical best-approximation theorems (Dirichlet / Legendre / semiconvergents of log 2 / log 3), so the successor of 478245 is forced without scanning 301995 lengths and is structurally distinct from the k=1 blocker.
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / continued fraction of log 2 / log 3
tested_range: stored flight-anchor leftovers in [478245, 780239] at n=3.5e8; leftover-seed cone 478245 + a*25781 + b*50508 + c*176251 + d*301994; Dirichlet / Legendre versus crude finance epsilon; six multi-generator defect-product checks
counterexamples: leftover/Dirichlet = 36.28 at L=478245 and 96.57 at L=780239; Legendre is twice as far, so CF classification does not list the leftovers
the leftover-seed cone has 46 o-minimal points against 11 leftovers; extra 529807 = 478245+2*25781 still beats the crude leftover cap
theta(780239)/theta(478245) = 0.9818 and the DK margin drops 1.0053 to 0.6048: k=2 is the same dangerous approximation with a worse margin
notes: Phase 0 only. The defect product theta(L+M)=theta(L)+theta(M)-theta(L)theta(M) is exact and is not new. The flight-anchor scan remains the completeness proof. Fan-minimum unbounded-PQ question is not reopened. Not a halt theorem, not a floor raise, not a Paper A edit.
